findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts:447,454-458,460,462,469,485,1000-1001 — session_brief next-step and anti-stall output still emits bare command names (for example reviewer_list, review_run_start, review_pass_set, story_advance) instead of lattice-prefixed examples. CHK-002 requires user-facing help banners and next-step hints to prefer lattice by default, so the session output is still inconsistent with the item scope.

User-facing hints and the session brief reminder still recommend koala validate, koala next, or koala session_brief; B-fd03 requires lattice as the primary recommended CLI and koala only as explicit legacy compatibility.

README.md:45-53 and docs/guide.md:41-49 call this the local/global refresh flow, but they stop at lattice --version and never tell the user to verify the legacy koala alias. CHK-001 explicitly requires verifying lattice/koala versions, and the story background says stale koala-facing guidance after refresh is the rollout problem. As written, the docs cannot confirm that the alias also refreshed to 0.3.5. Add an explicit koala --version or equivalent alias verification step to the refresh flow.
